name: Textile with Phoenixes and Dragons
dimensions: Overall: 20.3 x 20 cm (8 x 7 7/8 in.); Mounted: 31.4 x 31.1 cm (12 3/8 x 12 1/4 in.)
summary: This is one of the very few northern Chinese silk and gold textiles to have survived from the Yuan dynasty.
